description: Takealot.com (South Africa) product search from the JSON API the Takealot website uses: product ID (PLID), title, brand, price or price range in ZAR, list price, saving badge, star rating, review count, stock status, delivery estimate, image and product URL, plus the total result count. Up to 36 products per call. Unofficial endpoint, may change without notice. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: Search words, e.g. iphone, air fryer (required, 2-80 chars)

sort.description: relevance (default), price_low, price_high, rating or newest
